headline: KARA's Heo Young Ji returns to DSP Media
sub: Back with her original agency about 2 years after leaving
source: Source: Official announcement from DSP Media
caption:
KARA's Heo Young Ji is going home to DSP Media!

DSP Media announced on Nov 25 that it recently signed an exclusive contract with Heo, about two years after her previous contract ended in Sept 2024. "As we reunite based on the trust we've built over a long time, we will give her our full support so she can show her abilities in many fields," the agency said. Heo joined KARA in 2014 and has also worked as an actress and TV personality.

📌 Source: DSP Media, via Korean media
